oracle.note: the reference itself, submitted as an answer -- what the scoring chain gives a perfect answer, and therefore the top of this case's scale

round_trip.submission: the reference graph, verbatim (a graph has no export step)
round_trip.note: equal to `oracle` by construction: tools.export writes the graph dict straight to pred_graph.json

baseline.submission: the empty graph template: the submission schema with no components, nets or incidences
baseline.note: the floor of this case: the submission template with nothing filled in. `harness/run.py --model mock/dumb` submits exactly this graph, so its score should match this number.
